about: Scenes where Miho Shirayuki (and her twin Maho) talks most, first found on Disc 4 (a scene on several discs is listed under the first). Edit only "en". One entry is one text box; \n separates its lines, and the English needs as many lines as the Japanese. See the README, 'Helping improve the translation'.
